title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the doubles tennis match between Cook/Sach and Ellis/Tu in the Brisbane 3, originally scheduled for November 11, 2026 at 7:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Cook/Sach' if the team of Cook/Sach advances against Ellis/Tu.

This market will resolve to 'Ellis/Tu' if the team of Ellis/Tu advances against Cook/Sach.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the team who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (a team withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
